name: Asante Meeting Rooms
provenance: Four Asante Meeting Rooms traced from UC San Diego International House's official floor plan. This is the meeting venue (CAAN 7025); the previously associated three-floor Asante W housing layout is preserved separately. Drawing units and floor height are illustrative.

coordinateSystem.description: One unit equals ten pixels in the original 700 × 546 floor-plan image. No metric dimensions or campus registration are claimed.
coordinateSystem.northNote: Source drawing orientation is preserved; no unambiguous north angle was established.

sources.scale: Relative image units; architectural scale not established.

rooms.label: 123D
rooms.name: Asante Meeting Room D
notes: Official plan label: AH123D. Official I-House FAQ capacity: 24 persons.
Principal visible walls traced; small columns and doorway recesses are simplified.
The source depicts a movable partition shared with Room 123A. The polygon represents the separately named room configuration.
Only the single meeting-room level depicted by the source is modeled. A and D are separated by the movable partition shown on the drawing.
The source image is undated and depicts one meeting-room level. The L1 identifier is retained from the prior schedule inventory; elevations and floor-to-floor height are not supplied by the plan.
Room boundaries follow visible walls and the movable partition. Wall thickness, small columns, door recesses and stair geometry are simplified; chairs and tables are omitted.
Relative drawing units are used. The published approximate rental areas and small furniture dimensions are not used to assert an architectural metric scale.
No reliable north angle or campus registration is established. The corrected campus map point and CAAN identify the venue but do not place this local indoor model on campus.
The original three-floor Asante W apartment layout remains preserved separately. Its 15 unscheduled shapes and service room 123D are not mixed into this meeting-room coordinate system.
